notes:
Summary: Mid-size EU financial platform evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) to replace a brittle self-hosted inference cluster. Primary ask is a hardened network design: PrivateLink endpoints into their VPC, optional VPC peering for non-prod, strict egress controls, static egress IPs and IP allowlists, and customer-managed KMS keys.

Key quotes: "We cannot accept any outbound egress that we can't control — all traffic must go through our NAT + egress proxy, and we need static IPs for allowlisting with partner banks." — CTO (Luc Moreau)

Security posture & requirements: SOC2/ISO27001 baseline, EU data residency for token-level logs, full audit logging forwarded into their SIEM (Splunk), support for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/CMEK) + key rotation policy, HSM optional for higher-sensitivity endpoints. SSO via SAML (Azure AD).

Network preferences: Prefers PrivateLink for production traffic (less routing complexity) but open to VPC peering for test clusters. Must support explicit firewall rules per endpoint, security groups managed by their NetOps. Wants documentation for IP ranges by region, CIDR recommendations, and guidance for overlapping address spaces. Important: route table modifications need change window coordination.

Operational asks: runbook for onboarding VPC (step-by-step), sample CloudFormation/Terraform module, instructions to configure PrivateLink endpoints, recommended firewall rules, egress NAT design, health-check ports and ports to allow, and sample IP allowlist format for partner integrations. Also requested examples for forwarding audit logs to Splunk (CloudTrail + S3 + Kinesis Firehose pattern).

Commercial / timing: evaluation POC expected for 6 weeks. Estimated ARR band discussed in exec call. Security questionnaire submitted 2025-01-30; follow-up items returned 2025-02-12. Pen test requirement: customer may require Redwood to share latest pen-test summary or run a scoped test.

Misc: Drive doc contains network diagram + security questionnaire responses. GAAP procurement timeline implies legal sign-off earliest mid-April. SE deep-dive recorded in Fireflies (see id).
